rationale: The assistant correctly said the hood is separate from the hob, then told the customer to stop using it, isolate the power, and call Bosch or an engineer. It never named the spur switch the customer had mentioned, and the first reply gave a lot of speculative cause detail and a hand-spinning step the customer couldn't do. It also never said plainly that hoods are outside the service's scope. The second reply was strong on safety and handled the warm smell well, though its fire-risk wording was slightly dramatic and it said to cut power at the breaker without mentioning the spur.
